description:
Machina Cognita Technologies is an R&D-driven company specializing in machine learning innovations for government, commercial, and educational applications. We embrace today’s most exciting machine learning challenges with technologies including uncrewed autonomous systems, large language models, realistic simulation environments, computer vision, and reinforcement learning.

 

We are looking for a Software Engineer who thrives on tackling complex problems and pushing the boundaries of new technologies. In this role, you’ll partner closely with clients to understand their pain points, conceptualize forward-thinking solutions, and collaborate with other engineers to bring your ideas to life. You’ll gain end-to-end exposure, expand your creative freedom, and hone a wide-ranging skillset as you contribute across the full software development life cycle.

 

This is a full-time, onsite role split between Point Loma and Carlsbad.

 

Required

 - An active DoW Secret security clearance is required for this role



Who You Are

 - Energized by open-ended technical challenges in early-stage product development

 - Turns failures into learning opportunities

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

 - 2-5 years of professional software development experience

 - Proficient in Python, JavaScript, and Bash

 - Proficient in command-line tooling and shell scripting

 - Proficient in containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes

 - Experience with government and defense contracts (SBIR/STTR) or DoW end users is a plus

 - Strong communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills

 

Responsibilities

 - Build proof-of-concept prototypes and client demonstrations to win contract bids and drive new business opportunities

 - Design, develop, and launch new features, applications, and services

 - Contribute to system architecture and technical design discussions

 - Monitor system performance and identify and resolve issues to improve reliability

 - Develop and maintain APIs, integrations, and backend services

 - Run pilot implementations, troubleshoot issues, and drive resolution

 - Collaborate with product manager and engineers to translate client needs into innovative solutions

 - Travel to client destinations to facilitate product delivery and provide ongoing support and optimization

 

Compensation

Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, ability, education, certifications, specialized skills, business needs, and scope and responsibilities of the position. The estimated range for this role is $120,000-$150,000.

 

Benefits

 - Safe Harbor 401(k) with 4% employer match

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance with 99% employer contribution towards employee premiums

 - Flexible work hours + inclusive PTO policy to support work-life balance

 - Onsite gym

 - Professional development reimbursement for continual learning

 - Freedom to explore, create, play, and problem-solve while receiving support and guidance from senior leaders

 - Every engineer, at every level, has a voice in what projects we pursue and how we accomplish our technical goals

 

Machina Cognita Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, or other non-merit factors. We recognize and appreciate the value of a diverse workforce and encourage all qualified individuals to apply.
